gscript im — the IM index/linter (imindex) over the operator memory hub

USAGE:
  gscript im lint   [--hub <path>] [--budget N] [--warn-pct N] [--deep] [--verbose]
  gscript im digest [--hub <path>] [--budget N]

OPTIONS:
  --hub <path>       the hub CLAUDE.md (default: CLAUDE.md beside gscript.json's localmdPath)
  --budget N         hub line budget (default 450); exceeding it is an ERROR
  --warn-pct N       warn when usage reaches N% of budget (default 90)
  --archived-root R  pre-relocation root to warn on (repeatable; also <hubDir>\im.json archivedRoots)
  --deep             also stale-path-scan localmd/*.md beside the hub
  --verbose          list unverifiable paths (non-C:\work roots, other machines)

lint exits 1 on any error (budget overrun, stale C:\work path, broken `localmd/…` ref)
so it can gate a ceremony; archived-location references are warnings only.
